training.objective: nominal Cartesian delta MSE + 0.3 gripper BCE + coordinated-hold BCE
training.supervision: original geometric teacher; nominal motion and explicit centralized hazard-hold labels
training.age_policy: expiration/invalid-message conservative hold in runtime; no learned delay robustness claim

left.layer: SmolVLMWithExpertModel.forward: final normalized prefix hidden states
left.pooling: mean of valid image and language tokens; state and padding excluded
left.preprocessing: pinned saved SmolVLA processors; one local RGB duplicated in two camera slots

checkpoint.noise_stream: The same fixed probe seed is reused for each inference call.
limitations: Approximate cloth frame/embodiment transfer; no task adaptation or success claim.
Predicted rotation is ignored by the fixed-orientation gripper.
The caller supplies the task/coordination instruction; no phase teacher is invoked.
cloth_limitations: LIBERO checkpoint has no training for this cloth scene.
One local camera duplicated as front and wrist; rotation discarded.
Own tool orientation is approximated by fixed downward Euler angles, not estimated from image.
Table-frame xyz passed as approximate LIBERO coordinates; no frame calibration.

right.layer: XVLA.forward_vlm: Florence2 language_model.encoder final hidden states
right.pooling: mean of primary image and valid language tokens; language padding excluded
right.preprocessing: pinned saved X-VLA processors plus official ImageNet normalization; missing views masked

checkpoint.normalization: Saved processors plus official XVLA ImageNet normalization once; absent action statistics remain identity.
checkpoint.rotation_order: Interleaved first two matrix columns (Soft-FOLD reference); fixed approximate Rx(pi) tool orientation.
limitations: Unadapted robot/camera/action-frame transfer; no cloth success claim.
Only local arm pose and local camera are supplied; missing peer pose is zero.
Local orientation is an approximate fixed downward tool pose, not measured or calibrated.
Domain 5 follows the official Soft-FOLD Agilex deployment client; this simulation is a different embodiment.
Model outputs two Cartesian poses; only selected arm xyz/grip is executed; rotations ignored.
